resources.string: Set Byteward as your passkey provider in device settings.
Byteward auto-fill service
The easiest way to add new logins to your vault is from the Byteward Autofill Service. Learn more about using the Byteward Autofill Service by navigating to the “Settings” screen.
The Byteward auto-fill service uses the Android Autofill Framework to assist in filling login information into other apps on your device.
Set your PIN code for unlocking Byteward. Your PIN settings will be reset if you ever fully log out of the application.
URI match detection controls how Byteward identifies autofill suggestions.
Please turn on “Autofill Accessibility Service” from Byteward Settings to use the Autofill tile.

Byteward uses the Accessibility Service to search for login fields in apps and websites, then establish the appropriate field IDs for entering a username & password when a match for the app or site is found. We do not store any of the information presented to us by the service, nor do we make any attempt to control any on-screen elements beyond text entry of credentials.
This notice is required before Byteward can offer accessibility-based autofill.

Byteward offers an optional autofill method that uses Android’s Accessibility Service to detect login fields. If you enable it, Byteward will identify the appropriate fields and fill in your credentials when a match is found.
